title: MacNeal–Harder pinched cylinder

gates.description: Finest mesh (32x32) displacement within 3% of reference
Monotone convergence of displacement error with mesh refinement
Coarsest mesh (4x4) displacement within 50% of reference

limitations: Cylindrical Shell4 is specialised for cylindrical geometry only
General curved shells require either specialised elements or improved flat-facet formulations
Reference value is from a published benchmark; no independent analytical solution exists for this configuration
Non-monotone convergence observed: error at 8x8 (3.35%) exceeds 4x4 (2.86%), and 32x32 (1.82%) exceeds 16x16 (0.17%)
This is a known limitation of the cylindrical Shell4 formulation with selective reduced integration
